subject: Urgent: QPS spike — reserved pool not meeting committed throughput (intervention requested)
messages:
From: Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@granitebank.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-team@granitebank.com
Date: 2028-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Immediate: sustained 5xx + latency on reserved capacity

Priyom —

We started seeing a sustained spike in 5xxs and p95 latency across our production endpoints around 08:45 PT. Traffic volume is in line with our forecast, but the reserved pool for our contract is showing heavy QPS backpressure and token queueing. This is impacting critical customer flows (ACH settlement hitting timeouts).

Can Redwood please confirm: are you seeing saturation on the dedicated pool that services our reservation? We need an ETA on remediation and whether Granite Bank can expect automatic fallback to the hosted variants while capacity is addressed. This is impacting our operations team and traders are escalating.

Attached: a short PDF with screenshots and the earliest error traces.

— Jared
Head of Payments Ops, Granite Bank
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@granitebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Immediate: sustained 5xx + latency on reserved capacity

Jared —

Thanks for the heads up and very sorry for the disruption. I’ve looped in Ops/Infra and our priority accounts lead. Initial checks: we are seeing elevated GPU utilization and token-queue growth in the dedicated pool tagged GB-reserved-01.

Immediate actions we are initiating now:
- Spinning an emergency burst slice onto neighboring dedicated nodes (5-10m to finish warming).
- Enabling prefix KV cache bypass throttles for a subset of high-volume routes to lower token work per request.
- Routing low-SLO traffic to verified hosted variants (auto-fallback) once we have explicit sign-off from you.

Asks: 1) Can Granite confirm whether traffic shaping on your side (short-lived rate limits) is acceptable for the next 30–45 minutes while we stabilize? 2) Are any flows strictly not allowed to hit hosted fallbacks (regulatory/PCI concerns)?

I will post status updates every 15 minutes.

— Priyom
Principal Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Immediate: sustained 5xx + latency on reserved capacity

Team —

Ops notes from the cluster: we’re at sustained 95%+ GPU utilization on nodes in GB-reserved-01 and queue depth for token generation is spiking. Error rate correlates with token-queue timeouts. Preliminary hypothesis: a small number of long-context workloads (LLMs >8k) have been routed to the reserved pool without KV cache warm hits, increasing per-request token work significantly.

Short-term proposal (can be executed in parallel):
- Apply a temporary per-route concurrency cap (20% reduction) for non-critical endpoints.
- Promote a compiled-quantized variant to the reserved pool that reduces memory pressure (10–20% throughput gain observed in staging).
- If capacity still not sufficient after 10–15m, flip automatic fallback for the affected routes to the hosted variants we pre-qualified in the SOW.

I’ll coordinate the kernel swap and capacity slice with infra — Marcus, can you confirm ETA to warm a quantized variant and expected throughput improvement?

— Marissa
Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Immediate: sustained 5xx + latency on reserved capacity

We can warm the quantized variant to the reserved pool in ~12 minutes (image pull + kernel priming). Expected throughput gain: ~18% per-node on the heavy-attention paths; memory pressure drops which should reduce queue timeouts. Spinning the emergency burst slice is underway — slice should be online in ~6–8 minutes but will need traffic shifts to exercise.

I’m also running a quick scan to identify long-context requests and will push a short-term routing rule to prioritize smaller-sequence requests onto the new slice.

— Marcus
Sr. Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@granitebank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-18T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Immediate: sustained 5xx + latency on reserved capacity

Jared —

Quick update: we have an emergency slice warming (ETA 6–8m) and are priming a quantized variant (ETA 12m). To proceed with the hosted fallback we need your go-ahead for these routes: payment-verify, settlement-async, reconciliation-batch. Per your earlier contract notes, the hosted fallback is allowed for non-PII flows; please confirm that the above routes are acceptable.

If you need strict isolation for settlement-async, we can prioritize making the quantized variant available to the reserved pool only and avoid hosted routing, but that may increase time-to-stable. Please let me know now so we can either switch to fallback or continue with internal-only mitigations.

— Priyom
From: Jared Bloom <jared.bloom@granitebank.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: ops-team@granitebank.com
Date: 2028-06-18T09:46:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Immediate: sustained 5xx + latency on reserved capacity

Priyom —

Authorize the fallback for payment-verify and reconciliation-batch. Settlement-async must remain on reserved hardware — we cannot risk cross-tenant routing for settlement flows. We will apply a temporary 15% rate cap on settlement-async from our side for the next 45 minutes to help stabilize. Please confirm when the quantized variant is live.

— Jared
